question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 1), i.e., "Friwsk."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is '**Frisk**.'
 
• '**Frisk**' means 'skip or leap playfully; frolic.' (क्रीड़ा करना; एक खुश, ऊर्जावान तरीके से घूमना)
 
• **Example**:
 
 
• Everyone was frisked before getting on the plane.
 
 
 
• Therefore, 'Friwsk' is incorrectly spelt among the given options.
 
• Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.​

​
